title: Re-qualify the latest UI feedback in isolated scratch
objective: Verify all five corrections (shortcut ±15min, Intention readability, Day Setup hierarchy, quarantined row containment, Results/Preview status hierarchy) with focused suites, rebuilt bundles, and screenshot-derived browser scenarios on scratch port 8790 only. Zero live writes, zero billed calls, zero restarts, zero commits.

method.suites: frontend vitest (npm test), tsc typecheck (npm run typecheck), vite mockup build, vite production build; bundles read back from rebuilt source.
method.browser: Rebuilt mockup (FixtureAdapter, __FIXTURE__) served GET-only on scratch 127.0.0.1:8790 (python3 -m http.server --directory mockups/cockpit); driven by playwright-core 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05 against cached chromium_headless_shell-1234; scenario per URL hash (#fresh/#sequenced/#commit-preview/#verified/#conflict); debug handle window.__tdtb used only to dispatch INPUTS_LOADED with a quarantined calendar row (display-only) and Mint session semantics (display-only); console/pageerror/requestfailed/response>=400/non-GET collectors on every page; horizontal overflow measured on documentElement+body at 1280 and 390 widths; dialog-scoped overflow measured for Day Setup at 390.
method.a11y_visual_regression: Configured a11y and visual-regression automation unavailable (quality.a11y_audit_level=none, quality.visual_regression_enabled=false) - skipped entirely per config; screenshots are evidence artifacts only, no baseline diff; keyboard/focus/overflow assertions are behavioral browser checks, not an a11y audit.
